test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Hasn’t India established the air travel bridge to the Maldives?

options.text: Hasn’t the air travel bridge to the Maldives been established by India?
Shouldn’t the air travel bridge to the Maldives be established by India?
Why hasn’t the air travel bridge to the Maldives been established by India?
Isn't India established the air travel bridge to the Maldives?

solution:
The correct answer is- 'Hasn’t the air travel bridge to the Maldives been established by India?' 

***__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is an interrogative sentence and it is in the present perfect tense.

 
 
• So the structure for conversion is

 
 
• *has/have + subject + been + verb (3rd form) + object ?*
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Has he (**subject**) packed (**verb**) the clothes in the cupboard? *(active)
 
• Have the clothes (**subject**) been packed (**verb**) in the cupboard by him? *(passive)* *
 
 
 
 
 
 

Thus *option 1 *is the correct answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's understand how the sentence structure changes in present tense while converting from active to passive voice:

 
 
• Simple present - *subject + is/am/are + verb (3rd form) + object*

 
 
• *​*Example: *Football is played by him.*
 
 
 
• Present continuous - *subject + is/am/are + being + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
 
• *​*Example: *The car is being driven by him.*
 
 
 
• Present perfect - *subject + has/have + been + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
 
• *​*Example: *The car has been driven by him.​​​*
